signal: XOi raised $230M from KKR, acquired Specifx, and launched Advisor, an AI asset-intelligence tool helping field-service sales teams survey sites and quote faster

email.body1:
Gamble, saw XOi's $230M raise from KKR, the Specifx acquisition, and the Advisor launch for field-service teams.

Growth and an expanded platform usually mean more in-market accounts than the BD team can cover, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for XOi off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Gamble, quick follow-up for XOi.

After a raise that size, the pipeline expectation on BD climbs faster than headcount can. Most reps don't actually know how many meetings they need booked to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings XOi needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Gamble, last bit of proof for XOi.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how XOi's reply rate likely compares to other field-service software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Gamble, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating an acquisition and a new product after a raise is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to XOi either way.
